title: Mochizuki Honami — With All Our Supporters〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Our Thank You Show is coming along nicely.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And I'm so glad we had a chance to invite Ms. Yoisaki...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki and Shiho said they've been able to invite everyone they were meaning to...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So, I need to do the same.)
Hoonaamiii♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting us out to go shopping with you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I should be thanking you.
I know you're both very busy, so I really appreciate you joining me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I've really been looking forward to shopping with you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it's so unfortunate that Mizuki couldn't also join us...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I wouldn't worry too much about that.
It's Mizuki's fault for not going to school more often.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At the same time, I do feel kinda bad, so I might look for a treat or something.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, would you mind giving me a moment before we go? There's something I need to give the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Give us?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So... Here, these are tickets to our next show! One for each of you, and another for Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! Tickets to your next show?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, we can really have these?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. The thing is, our next show is about...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: ...and you wanna thank everyone who's been supporting you all this time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still, are you sure?
You sorta just met Mizuki the other day.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And all I did was teach you how to draw a little. I haven't actually done anything for your band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I'm sure!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You showed me just how much fun it is to draw. As a result, I've been helping do illustrations for our band's flyers.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, we're not just talking about the people who've been directly involved with our band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Be it with school or everyday life...
We've been able to make it this far because so many people have been there to help us along the way.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, if we mean that much to you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I happily accept.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope you'll also come watch if you have time, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You've been a dear friend and an enormous source of support even before we got our band back together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know I've thanked you quite a bit already... But I'd like to thank you again, through our music this time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah☆ I'm absolutely, positively going♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Friends forever, right, Honami☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...! Hehe. Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, thank you for giving me a chance to do this. Shall we get going?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo☆ Let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Actually, Honami...
You said just now that you've been helping do illustrations for your band's flyers. Do you happen to have one on you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna see what you drew too♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Yes, I have a few on me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, why don't we play that game again where you both try to guess what I drew?
